CMOS delay-XOR frequency doubler
.include "circuit.spice"
.include "models.spice"
VDD vdd 0 3.3
VCLK clk 0 PULSE(0 3.3 50n 100p 100p 49.9n 100n)
XDUT vdd 0 clk out astra_064_cmos_delay_xor_frequency_doubler
.temp 27
.options method=gear reltol=1e-5
* @spec rise_peak range 3.2 3.4 unit=V
* @spec fall_peak range 3.2 3.4 unit=V
* @spec quiet range -0.02 0.1 unit=V
* @spec period range 4e-8 6e-8 unit=s
* @spec width1 range 5e-9 2.5e-8 unit=s
* @spec width2 range 5e-9 2.5e-8 unit=s
.control
set filetype=ascii
tran 20p 400n
meas tran rise_peak MAX v(out) FROM=50n TO=80n
meas tran fall_peak MAX v(out) FROM=100n TO=130n
meas tran quiet MAX v(out) FROM=82n TO=95n
meas tran period TRIG v(out) VAL=1.65 RISE=3 TARG v(out) VAL=1.65 RISE=4
meas tran width1 TRIG v(out) VAL=1.65 RISE=1 TARG v(out) VAL=1.65 FALL=1
meas tran width2 TRIG v(out) VAL=1.65 RISE=2 TARG v(out) VAL=1.65 FALL=2
write out.raw v(out) v(clk)
quit
.endc
.end
